_how_it_works: Can't-Miss Shows (HOT) in the Next 30 Days view. Only shows listed here are featured. Order = priority: the site features the first 5 that are in the next 30 days, pass the visitor's filters and aren't canceled, postponed or sold out, and shows them soonest first; when one passes, the next moves up. Each entry names an event in events.json by its exact 'link' AND 'date' (the site's event ID), with one specific 'why' line, the 'signals' it meets, short 'evidence' links and the date the evidence was 'checked'. A show qualifies with ONE STRONG signal: headliner scale (an arena/amphitheater headliner or an act on a major festival's headline bill, on its own tour, not a tribute); a multi-night run in a big room; a date added or venue upgraded because of demand; a rare or returning Arizona stop (first time in years, reunion, comeback, farewell tour, an artist who rarely tours or usually skips Arizona); a hometown release show or homecoming; a one-off collaboration. Or TWO different SUPPORTING signals: a multi-night club run, an earlier sold-out run, new release or award news, an anniversary show, a co-headline or distinctive local lineup, low tickets reported by the seller. Suggestions arrive weekly in hot-candidates.json; check the evidence before approving.

approved.title: Rush (night 2)

approved.title: The Neighbourhood w/ Nessa Barrett

approved.why: Gracie Abrams went from the Lollapalooza 2025 headline bill to her first headlining arena tour, and Glendale gets two nights of it (Dec. 9 and 10) with Rachel Chinouriri opening.

approved.title: Jonas Brothers
approved.why: The Jonas Brothers turned their sold-out three-night Burning Up celebration at Madison Square Garden into a 45-city arena tour, and Glendale gets it the night after Thanksgiving.

approved.why: President Gator's 25th-anniversary party puts Phoenix-born Miniature Tigers on the same Van Buren bill as Tempe's Gospel Claws, with Pollen and Breakup Shoes rounding it out.
